amendments.reason: the harness refuses to start unless its own worst-case bound fits the cap: 3 repeats x 3 arms x 7 model calls = 63, plus 3 repeats x max_summary_calls. With the default 16 the bound is 111 > 66, so the native arm's summary budget is set to one call per sample, which makes the bound exactly 66 - the frozen cap. The cap itself is unchanged, no cap was raised, and the acceptance line does not involve the native arm.
amendments.consequence: the native summary arm's measured cost on this batch is a bounded lower bound of its unbounded cost; it is reported with that qualifier
